_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name.
You are mine, says the Lord.
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you.
You are mine, says the Lord.
A voice came from heaven: You are my beloved.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Feel the water — cold, then warm, running down, the river closing over and opening again.
You are my beloved; with you I am well pleased.
The same voice that thundered over the deep speaks now, gentle, over you.
You are my beloved; with you I am well pleased.
Do not fear; you have been called by name, and the waters cannot sweep you away.
You are my beloved; with you I am well pleased.
Heaven opens; the Spirit descends; and the word over Jesus is the word over you.
You are my beloved; with you I am well pleased!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Called by name, you pass through the waters unafraid.
You are my beloved; with you I am well pleased.
The voice over the deep speaks gently over you.
You are my beloved; with you I am well pleased.
Heaven opens, the Spirit falls, the word is spoken.
You are my beloved. Come, let us worship. Amen.
